creating an index for intent

```{r}
poss_effect_cols <- c("パス成功率",
                      "前方パス比率",
                      "ロングパス比率",
                      "ロングパス成功率",
                      "サイドから前へのパス",
                      "サイドチェンジ回数",
                      "味方の成功横パススピード標準偏差")  

pass_effect_stats <- df[,poss_effect_cols]

cor(pass_effect_stats)


vars <- apply(pass_effect_stats, 2, var)
pass_effect_stats <- pass_effect_stats[, vars > 1e-5]

cor_matrix <- cor(pass_effect_stats)
which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.99 & abs(cor_matrix) < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)

parallel_effect <- fa.parallel(scale(pass_effect_stats), fa = "fa", n.iter = 100)

effect_fa_result <- fa(scale(pass_effect_stats), nfactors = 1, rotate = "varimax", fm = "minres", scores = "regression")

df$poss_effectiveness <- effect_fa_result$scores[,1]

```



```{r}
pass_intent_cols <- c("前方パス数",
                      "後方パス数",
                      "右方向パス数",
                      "左方向パス数",
                      "前方パス比率",
                      "ロングパス比率",
                      "サイドから前へのパス",
                      "サイドチェンジ回数",
                      "味方の横パススピード平均", 
                      "buildup_回数", 
                      "サイドから前へのパス_正規化")


pass_intent_stats <- df[, pass_intent_cols]

#Remove any near-zero variance columns
vars <- apply(pass_intent_stats, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
pass_intent_stats <- pass_intent_stats[, vars > 1e-5]


cor_matrix <- cor(pass_intent_stats, use = "complete.obs")
which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.99 & abs(cor_matrix) < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)

fa.parallel(scale(pass_intent_stats), fa = "fa", n.iter = 100)


intent_fa_result <- fa(scale(pass_intent_stats), nfactors = 1, rotate = "varimax", fm = "minres", scores = "regression")

#Store the score in your dataframe
df$poss_intent <- intent_fa_result$scores[,1]






```

```{r}
df$被ポゼッション率 <- 100 - df[,"ポゼッション率"]

result_metrics <- c("goal_diff",
                    "xg",
                    "被xg",
                    "シュート数",
                    "被シュート数", 
                    "PA侵入回数",
                    "被PA侵入回数",
                    "デュエル勝率",
                    "バイタルで受けた回数")

result_stats <- df[, result_metrics]


vars <- apply(result_stats, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
result_stats <- result_stats[, vars > 1e-5]


fa.parallel(scale(result_stats), fa = "fa", n.iter = 100)

result_fa <- fa(scale(result_stats), nfactors = 1, rotate = "varimax", fm = "minres", scores = "regression")


df$result_factor <- result_fa$scores[, 1]
df$match_label <- paste(df$season, df$対戦相手, sep = " vs ")


```

```{r}


plot_possession_map(df, "poss_intent", "poss_effectiveness")
df_2025 <- df %>% filter(df$season == 2025)
plot_possession_map(df_2025, "poss_intent", "poss_effectiveness")
df_2024 <- df %>% filter(df$season == 2024)
plot_possession_map(df_2024, "poss_intent", "poss_effectiveness")
```




```{r}
result_stats_scaled <- scale(result_stats)

# Determine optimal number of clusters
wss <- map_dbl(1:10, ~kmeans(result_stats_scaled, centers = .x, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss)
plot(1:10, wss, type = "b", main = "エルボー法によるクラスタ数選定", xlab = "クラスタ数", ylab = "WSS")

# Run k-means with optimal k (say, 3 or 4)
set.seed(123)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(result_stats_scaled, centers = 4, nstart = 25)

df$match_cluster <- factor(kmeans_result$cluster)

```

```{r}

ggplot(df, aes(x = poss_intent, y = poss_effectiveness, color = match_cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "クラスタごとのポゼッションマップ", x = "ポゼッション意図", y = "ポゼッション効果")

cluster_filter <- df %>%
  group_by(match_cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(result_metrics), mean, na.rm = TRUE), n = n())


```

```{r}


cluster_vars <- c("poss_intent", "poss_effectiveness", "result_factor")
cluster_data <- na.omit(df[, cluster_vars])
scaled_data <- scale(cluster_data)

# k-means on the three factor scores (elbow plot suggested 3-4; 3 used)
wss <- map_dbl(1:10, ~kmeans(scaled_data, centers = .x, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss)
plot(1:10, wss, type = "b", xlab = "クラスタ数", ylab = "WSS", main = "Elbow Method")
set.seed(42)
poss_kmeans <- kmeans(scaled_data, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
df$poss_cluster <- NA
df$poss_cluster[as.numeric(rownames(cluster_data))] <- poss_kmeans$cluster
df$poss_cluster <- factor(df$poss_cluster)


pca_result <- prcomp(scaled_data)


scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])
scores$match_label <- df$match_label[as.numeric(rownames(cluster_data))]
scores$poss_cluster <- df$poss_cluster[as.numeric(rownames(cluster_data))]


loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation[, 1:2])
loadings$var <- rownames(loadings)


ggplot(scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = poss_cluster, label = match_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(family = "jp", size = 2.5, check_overlap = TRUE, vjust = 1.2, hjust = 0) +

  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * 2, yend = PC2 * 2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               color = "black",
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  geom_text(data = loadings,
            aes(x = PC1 * 2.2, y = PC2 * 2.2, label = var),
            size = 3,
            family = "jp",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  labs(
    title = "poss/result kmeans clustering",
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "jp")

df %>%
  group_by(poss_cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(cluster_vars), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

```
